{
  "mcpServers": {
    "n8n-mcp": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "n8n-mcp"],
      "env": {
        "N8N_URL": "https://n8n.woowtech.io",
        "N8N_API_KEY": "<你的 API key，在 n8n Settings → API 建立>"
      }
    }
  }
}
entries.en:
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "n8n-mcp": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["-y", "n8n-mcp@2.79.0"],
      "env": {
        "N8N_API_URL": "https://n8n.example.com",
        "N8N_API_KEY": "<your API key, created under n8n Settings → n8n API>"
      }
    }
  }
}
